# Quotes and nested lists

> This quotation keeps its paragraphs, lists, and nested quotation together.
>
> A second paragraph introduces the following list.
>
> - The first item contains **bold text** and a continuation that wraps in a narrow window.
> - A second item introduces a nested list:
>   1. First nested item.
>   2. Second nested item with `inline code`.
>      - One more level stays visibly inside its parent.
>
> > This nested quotation has two paragraphs.
> >
> > Its second paragraph keeps the same inset and border.
>
> The final paragraph returns to the outer quotation.

## Tasks and alerts

> [!WARNING]
> Keep the list inside the warning.
>
> - [x] A completed task.
> - [ ] An open task.
>
> This is still part of the same warning.

## Quotes inside lists

1. An outer item with a quotation:

   > A quotation inside the item.
   >
   > Another quoted paragraph.
   >
   > - A list inside that quotation.

2. The next item returns to the outer list.
